state_contract: Host config and catalog_path; pause, identity, receipt and source-hash protections unchanged
import_side_effects: No new service/browser/model starts; capabilities preserve their original explicit call side effects
compatibility: New projects use canonical packages and public APIs; existing resident entries are served only by pipeline adapters

owner_supervision__tick.description: Original HTTP-only watcher check. Approval requires module_sha256 and external_dependencies to match the validated release and the live kernel report to be complete, so a drift in one outside file invalidates the release instead of handing off.

owner_supervision__publish_validated.description: Register the exact source plus the external kernel evidence actually tested (verification.external_dependencies must equal the live report and be status ok). Writes schema_version 2 and does not restart anything.

side_effects: 本地维护、归档或明确管理命令；浏览器维护只发给原所有者。
selection_and_retention: 维护沿用原三个LaunchAgent之一，不增加入口、不另连CDP。备份与恢复工具作为当前数据的按需管理接口保留，恢复只产出独立候选；本次新增结构检查替代旧符号链接迁移脚本。
runtime_activation: No automatic start/resume; existing controls and sole owner remain authoritative

runtime_link_migration_contract.plan: derive original parent geometry; only broken relative runtime links to configured SSD; preserve current valid links
runtime_link_migration_contract.apply: exact link and dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime CAS; atomic link replacement only; target bytes unchanged
runtime_link_migration_contract.limits: does not restore tasks or send model requests; changed or ambiguous evidence remains blocked
runtime_link_migration_contract.resume_link_blocked_materials: separate explicit CLI: only repaired paper IDs, local file-not-found correction failures, no current receipt, full source/frozen/history/task/pause checks and SQLite CAS; original FIFO and retry counters unchanged

review_preparation_recovery.eligibility: Only known pre-dispatch local preparation errors, empty result, current unchanged source/card, no human protection, no request/response history or page assignment
review_preparation_recovery.behavior: Reuse verified frozen bytes or independent new-ID candidate; 60MB ZIP; original artifacts untouched; database/job/packet CAS and events; no browser IO

test_runner_contract.output: PAPER_TEST_SUMMARY= JSON; actual overall counts, coverage gaps and source errors are separate

exit_codes.0: all requested suites executed successfully with valid source/receipts
exit_codes.1: missing/empty suites, discovery/source/receipt errors, or test failures

test_runner_contract.crawler: separate current-interpreter child with explicit workspace and explorer cwd; internal --crawler-child protocol
test_runner_contract.side_effects: existing isolated test fixtures and test subprocesses only; no automatic business start
test_runner_contract.isolation: test methods and loaded workspace components must resolve inside current workspace; snapshot component import roots precede installed .pth roots

http_watch_recovery_boundary: Shared HTTP watcher only inventories and requests registered owner maintenance; no TTL claim release, receipt moves, submitted reruns, material refill or cleanup; legacy recovery CLIs delegate.
